decisions.reason: The indoor air quality sensor remains a low-cost sensing option with enough remaining market uncertainty to justify keeping it open.
As an established core voltage measurement module, it has low uncertainty and is important for the platform, so it should be kept.
The MQTT software proxy has very low keeping costs and continues to provide valuable connectivity options, so keep it open.
The CO2 sensor module remains aligned with environmental sensing and cheap to keep, so its option value is still worth retaining.
